title: Vertical Speaker Cut With Captions
tests: Tests portrait reframing combined with accurate, synchronized, readable burned-in speech captions.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: White captions sit over her light shirt without a sufficiently dark outline or background, reducing contrast and readability.
The greeting ends with a period instead of the required exclamation mark.

judge.summary: The portrait edit centres her and presents the complete wording in short chunks below her face, but the captions need stronger contrast and the greeting punctuation corrected.

must_haves.item: The output is a 9:16 edit of the attached footage, with the woman centred and her face fully visible.
must_haves.why: The output frames are 9:16, show the same woman and setting, and keep her centred with her entire face visible.

must_haves.item: The full 10 seconds and original voice are preserved in sync.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound description confirms a 10-second output with the expected speech, but original-voice preservation and audiovisual sync cannot be verified from still frames and a transcript.

must_haves.item: Visible captions reproduce 'Hi everyone! Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.' in order, with no omitted or invented words.
must_haves.why: All spoken words appear in order across the sampled captions, without omitted or added words; the greeting punctuation differs.

must_haves.item: Captions appear in short readable chunks timed to the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript throughout.
must_haves.why: The frames show three successive short caption chunks rather than the whole transcript, but their precise correspondence to speech cannot be established from the untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: Captions have clear contrast, stay fully within the frame and do not cover her face.
must_haves.why: The captions are fully within the frame and below her face, but white lettering against her pale shirt lacks clear contrast.
